Baby shower planning questions, answered.
What baby shower services does Luxe provide?

Luxe provides mobile coffee and matcha service, live dessert preparation, and event rentals including chairs, tables, cocktail tables, tents, linens, and lighting. The right selection depends on the venue, guest count, schedule, and desired atmosphere.
Can the Coffee Bar, Sweet Cart, and rentals be booked separately?
Yes. Luxe Coffee Bar, Luxe Sweet Cart, and Luxe Seating Rentals can each be booked independently or coordinated within one baby shower plan.
What desserts can be prepared at a baby shower?

Luxe Sweet Cart can prepare mini Dutch pancakes, Belgian waffles on a stick, or mini donuts on-site. Soft serve is an optional enhancement. Dessert choices, sauces, toppings, quantities, and service format are confirmed during planning.
Can drinks, menus, signage, and cups be personalized?

Yes. Signature beverages, menu displays, cups, signage, cart details, dessert presentation, and selected rental details can be discussed. Final possibilities depend on the approved direction, production requirements, timing, and selected experience.
Can Luxe support an outdoor baby shower?
Yes. Outdoor service can be considered when weather planning, surface conditions, access, utilities, equipment protection, guest comfort, and a suitable contingency plan are confirmed.
What venue requirements are needed for mobile coffee service?

Requirements depend on the selected coffee format, menu, venue, and whether the event is indoors or outdoors. Luxe confirms the service footprint and any required power or water access during planning.
Does Luxe provide delivery, setup, and teardown?

Setup and takedown are included with confirmed Coffee Bar and Sweet Cart experiences. Rental delivery, setup, teardown, pickup responsibilities, access requirements, and applicable fees are confirmed for the venue and order.
Does Luxe serve baby showers outside Toronto?
Yes. Luxe primarily serves Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, with select events available throughout Southern Ontario. Travel or delivery fees may apply.
How many guests can Luxe serve?

Luxe supports intimate gatherings through larger celebrations. Capacity depends on the selected experience, service duration, menu, staffing, venue access and guest flow. Larger events can be reviewed individually.
How far in advance should a baby shower be booked?

Earlier inquiries provide more flexibility, especially for peak dates, personalized details, rentals, or coordinated services. Availability and production timing depend on the event date, selected experiences, staffing, inventory, and venue requirements.

Every coffee booking includes the selected Café Cart or Signature Coffee Bar format, barista-served specialty coffee, premium espresso equipment, four café favourites, hot and iced service, two signature coffee drinks, one premium non-coffee beverage, dairy and premium milk alternatives, syrups and sauces, a menu display, serving essentials, setup, and takedown.
What is the difference between the two coffee experiences?

The Café Cart is appropriate when the event needs an intimate, focused café point that sits quietly within the setting. The full-service Signature Coffee Bar is appropriate when coffee should have a larger footprint and a more prominent hospitality role. Both are complete, staffed Luxe experiences; guest count, service duration, venue, menu, available space, and desired visibility determine the better fit.
How does a coffee cart compare with traditional coffee catering?

Traditional coffee catering often prioritizes straightforward batch service or a self-serve beverage point, which can be appropriate when speed and simplicity matter most. A staffed coffee cart prepares made-to-order espresso, matcha, and other selected drinks and makes service part of the guest experience. Compare the required menu, service style, guest-arrival pattern, operating window, space, and budget before choosing.
How does outside coffee service compare with venue coffee service?

Venue coffee service can be the practical choice when it is already integrated with the venue's catering team, schedule, and banquet setup. A dedicated Luxe bar is useful when the event calls for made-to-order specialty drinks, dedicated baristas, a distinct service point, or branded presentation. Review the venue's included menu, outside-vendor rules, service timing, placement, utilities, and guest flow before deciding.
